aatrox.playstyle: Lane bully with teamfight drain-tanking. Land Q sweetspots for knockups and healing.

ahri.playstyle: Safe burst mage with high mobility. Charm to pick targets, Spirit Rush for repositioning.

akali.playstyle: High-skill AP assassin. Stealth zone allows extended trading. Double-dash R for kill pressure.

akshan.playstyle: Roaming mid marksman. Unique revive passive rewards tracking kills.

alistar.playstyle: Engage tank support. W+Q combo for reliable knockup. R makes you near-unkillable.

ambessa.playstyle: Aggressive fighter with energy management. Passive dashes enable relentless aggression.

amumu.playstyle: Teamfight jungle tank. Double Q engages. R is game-winning AoE stun.

annie.playstyle: Simple burst mage. Stack passive to 4, Flash+R for AoE stun combo.

ashe.playstyle: Utility ADC. Global R for picks. Perma-slow with autos. Hawkshot for vision.

aurelion_sol.playstyle: Infinite-scaling mage. Farm Stardust stacks. E for roaming. Upgraded R is fight-winning.

aurora.playstyle: Zone control battlemage. W hop for safety. R traps enemies in AoE.

bard.playstyle: Roaming support. Collect chimes for scaling. Q stun, E portals for creative plays. R for game-changing stasis.

blitzcrank.playstyle: Pick support. Land Q hook to win fights. Q→E→R combo deletes squishies.

brand.playstyle: AoE damage mage. Stack Blaze for %HP explosion. R bounces in teamfights.

braum.playstyle: Defensive tank support. E blocks projectiles. Passive team stuns. R for engage.

caitlyn.playstyle: Lane bully ADC with longest base range. Trap control zones. Net for self-peel.

camille.playstyle: Precision diver. E wall-jump engage. Q true damage. R locks target in 1v1.

corki.playstyle: Hybrid damage poke/burst. Package roams. Mixed damage hard to itemize against.

darius.playstyle: Lane bully. Stack Hemorrhage to 5 then R execute. Resets in teamfights.

diana.playstyle: AP dive assassin/bruiser. Q+E dash combo. R for teamfight AoE grouping.

dr_mundo.playstyle: Unkillable regen tank. Q poke in lane. R makes you impossible to burst down.

draven.playstyle: Snowball ADC. Catch axes for massive damage. Cash stacks on kills for gold lead.

ekko.playstyle: AP assassin with safety net. E+Q burst. W zoning. R for escape/damage/heal.

evelynn.playstyle: Jungle AP assassin. Invisible after 5. Charm into burst combo. R execute + escape.

ezreal.playstyle: Poke ADC with safety blink. Q spam + on-hit build. Global R for assists.

fiddlesticks.playstyle: Jungle teamfight mage. R from fog for AoE fear + massive damage.

fiora.playstyle: Ultimate 1v1 duelist. Proc vitals for %HP true damage. W parries any ability.

fizz.playstyle: AP assassin. E untargetable dodge. R fish for pick. All-in burst combo.

galio.playstyle: Anti-AP tank mage. W taunt for teamfights. R global follow-up for allies.

garen.playstyle: Simple lane-dominant juggernaut. Q silence, E spin damage, R true damage execute.

gnar.playstyle: Transform champion. Kite in Mini; engage in Mega. Manage rage for teamfight R.

gragas.playstyle: Versatile AP bruiser. E engage. R for displacement/isolation. W sustain.

graves.playstyle: Jungle bruiser ADC. Short-range shotgun bursts. E stacking armor for tankiness.

gwen.playstyle: AP bruiser duelist. W mist grants immunity to outside damage. Q for DPS.

hecarim.playstyle: Dive jungler. E charge into R teamfight fear. W sustain in fights.

heimerdinger.playstyle: Zone control mage. Turrets control lane. R+Q mega turret for fights.

irelia.playstyle: Mobile duelist. Q reset chains through minions. E stun setup. R for teamfight marks.

janna.playstyle: Peel enchanter. E shield + AD for carry. R disengage/heal in teamfights.

jarvan_iv.playstyle: Jungle diver. E+Q combo for knockup engage. R traps key targets.

jax.playstyle: Late-game duelist. E dodge for outplays. R gives tankiness + 3-hit passive.

jayce.playstyle: Form-swap poke/bruiser. Ranged E+Q for poke. Melee for all-in burst.

jhin.playstyle: Utility ADC. Fixed 4-shot with massive 4th shot crit. R for long-range picks.

jinx.playstyle: Hypercarry ADC. Get Excited passive enables resets in teamfights. Global R execute.

kaisa.playstyle: Hybrid ADC. Evolve abilities through items. R dash for assassination or repositioning.

kalista.playstyle: Kiting ADC. Constant dashing AAs. E rend for burst. R to save/engage with support.

karma.playstyle: Flex enchanter. R+E AoE shield/MS. R+Q for poke. R available at level 1.

kassadin.playstyle: Scaling assassin. Weak early; godlike after level 13. R blink = infinite mobility.

katarina.playstyle: Reset assassin. E to daggers for AoE. Get kill → all CDs reset → chain kills.

kayle.playstyle: Scaling hypercarry. Weak early (melee). Level 5 = ranged. Level 15 = godlike AoE.

kayn.playstyle: Form-evolving jungler. SA: squishy assassin. Rhaast: drain-tank bruiser. E wall-walk for ganks.

kennen.playstyle: Teamfight engage mage. Flash+R into enemy team for multi-stun AoE.

khazix.playstyle: Isolation assassin. Q deals massive single-target damage to isolated. R stealth resets passive.

kogmaw.playstyle: Hyperscaling ADC. W gives massive range + %HP on-hit. Needs peel to survive.

ksante.playstyle: Technical tank. Tanky in base form; R transforms into squishy damage dealer. High skill ceiling.

lee_sin.playstyle: Early game aggressor. Wardhop mobility. Insec kick (R enemy into team) is signature play.

leona.playstyle: All-in engage support. E engage → Q stun → R for AoE. Tanky with W.

lillia.playstyle: Speed-ramping AP jungler. Q stacks MS. R puts entire team to sleep for wombo.

lissandra.playstyle: Engage/lockdown mage. E to dive in, W root, R stasis for AoE. Anti-assassin with self-R.

lucian.playstyle: Combo ADC. Weave abilities + passive double-shots for burst DPS. Short range but high damage.

lulu.playstyle: Top-tier enchanter. W polymorph shuts down assassins. R saves carries with HP+knockup.

lux.playstyle: Long-range burst mage. Q root → E → R combo for kills. W shields team. Safe poke.

malphite.playstyle: Tank with game-winning R engage. Stacks armor. R into enemy team = instant teamfight win.

maokai.playstyle: CC tank support/jungle. W point-click root. R massive engage tool. E for vision.

master_yi.playstyle: Hypercarry melee. R = unstoppable. Q dodges abilities. Resets on kills = pentakill potential.

mel.playstyle: Burst mage with execution R. W shield for safety. Combo-oriented.

milio.playstyle: Protective enchanter. W zone heals and extends range. R is AoE Mikael's (team cleanse).

miss_fortune.playstyle: Lane bully ADC. Q bounce poke. R is devastating in narrow fights/objectives.

mordekaiser.playstyle: AP juggernaut. R forces 1v1 anyone. Passive aura melts in extended fights.

morgana.playstyle: Anti-engage support. E spell shield blocks all CC. Q has longest root in game.

nami.playstyle: Complete enchanter. Q bubble is strong CC. W heals+damages. E empowers carry. R engage/disengage.

nasus.playstyle: Infinite scaling juggernaut. Farm Q stacks. Late game 1v9 with 500+ stacks.

nautilus.playstyle: CC machine support. Every ability has CC. R is point-click knockup. Q hook engage.

nidalee.playstyle: High-skill form-swap jungler. Spear poke → cougar burst. Early game power. Heals allies.

nilah.playstyle: Melee ADC with dodge. W blocks all AAs. R pull + heal in teamfights. Needs specific support.

nocturne.playstyle: Dive assassin jungler. R darkness = terror. Dive carries with no counterplay vision.

norra.playstyle: Portal mage. Unique map control with portals. Abilities interact with portal system.

nunu.playstyle: Engage/objective jungle tank. W snowball for engage. Q smite for objectives. R for zone control.

olaf.playstyle: Unkillable berserker. R = CC immune. Low HP = more AS. E true damage ignores armor.

orianna.playstyle: Ball-control mage. Attach ball to diver → R Shockwave for game-winning 5-man CC combo.

ornn.playstyle: Team-scaling tank. Upgrades allies' items. R massive long-range engage. Brittle = bonus damage.

pantheon.playstyle: Early-game bully. W stun → empowered Q for burst. E blocks all frontal damage. R to roam.

poppy.playstyle: Anti-dash tank. W stops all dashes. E wall stun. R removes threats from fights.

pyke.playstyle: Assassin support. Hook → stun → R execute = gold for both you and ADC. Snowball machine.

rakan.playstyle: Engage enchanter. R+W dive for AoE charm+knockup. E to dash back to carry for safety.

rammus.playstyle: Anti-AD tank. Taunt carries into you → they kill themselves on reflected damage. Powerball for engage.

rell.playstyle: AoE CC tank. W knockup engage → R pulls enemies together → E stun with ally.

renekton.playstyle: Lane bully. E in → W stun → Q heal → E out. Dominates early game. Falls off late.

rengar.playstyle: Brush assassin. R stealth → leap → one-shot. Ferocity stacking for empowered abilities.

riven.playstyle: Animation-cancel combo fighter. High mobility + high burst. All AD scaling including shield.

rumble.playstyle: Heat management mage. R Equalizer is one of the best zone ults in game. Stay 50-100 Heat.

ryze.playstyle: Scaling battlemage. Mana scaling = unique builds. EQ combos for spread damage. R for team teleport.

samira.playstyle: Combo ADC. Build S rank through unique ability casts → R for massive AoE. W blocks projectiles.

senna.playstyle: Scaling support ADC. Infinite range scaling from mist. Q heals+damages. R global shield/damage.

seraphine.playstyle: Teamfight enchanter/mage. R charm chains through enemies. W team shield/heal. Q poke.

sett.playstyle: Wrestler juggernaut. W Haymaker true damage based on damage absorbed. R suplex carry into enemy team.

shen.playstyle: Global protector tank. R teleport to save ally anywhere. E taunt for engage. W blocks AAs.

shyvana.playstyle: AP bruiser jungler. Dragon form = massive AoE. E mark → AA for %max HP. Farm Fury for R.

singed.playstyle: Proxy farming madman. Run behind enemies, poison trail, flip into team. W grounds dashers.

sion.playstyle: Infinite HP scaling tank. W passive stacks HP. R cross-map engage. Q charged knockup.

sivir.playstyle: Waveclear ADC with team utility. E spell shield for safety. R team MS for engage.

smolder.playstyle: Infinite-scaling ADC. Farm Q stacks. At 225 = massive AoE explosions. R calls mom for teamfight.

sona.playstyle: Scaling enchanter. Auras buff team. R AoE stun. Late game team power is massive.

soraka.playstyle: Global healer support. W spam heals carry. R heals entire team from anywhere. E silence zone.

swain.playstyle: Drain-tank battlemage. Pull CC'd enemies. R drain form = massive AoE sustained damage in teamfights.

talon.playstyle: Roaming assassin. E parkour over walls = fastest roamer. Passive bleed for burst.

teemo.playstyle: Lane bully. Blind shuts down auto-attackers. Shrooms for map control + damage.

thresh.playstyle: Playmaker support. Hook engage. Lantern saves allies. Flay peels. R zones.

tristana.playstyle: All-in ADC. W jump reset on kills = snowball. E bomb burst. R self-peel.

tryndamere.playstyle: Split-push king. R = unkillable for 5s. Crit-based scaling. Forces 2+ to answer.

twisted_fate.playstyle: Map-control mage. R teleport ganks with Gold Card stun. Global pressure.

twitch.playstyle: Stealth ADC. Q invisible for flanks. R for teamfight AoE piercing autos.

urgot.playstyle: Ranged juggernaut. Rotate legs for %HP damage. R execute is terrifying finisher.

varus.playstyle: Hybrid poke ADC. Q poke. W blight stacks for %HP burst. R AoE root engage.

vayne.playstyle: Tank-shredding hypercarry. W true damage melts anyone. Short range demands skill.

veigar.playstyle: Infinite AP scaling mage. E cage is zone control. R point-click deletes squishies late.

velkoz.playstyle: Artillery mage. Geometry Q angles. R laser melts grouped enemies. Passive = true damage.

vex.playstyle: Anti-mobility burst mage. Fear dashing enemies. R dashes to target for burst.

vi.playstyle: Lockdown jungler. Q charge engage. R point-click suppress on priority target.

viego.playstyle: Reset assassin/bruiser. Kill → possess → heal → R reset. Snowball monster in teamfights.

viktor.playstyle: Scaling control mage. Evolved E = massive waveclear + poke. R zone control.

vladimir.playstyle: Scaling AP drain tank. W untargetable pool. R amplifies team damage. No mana = infinite sustain.

volibear.playstyle: Frontline bruiser. R disables turrets for dives. W sustain in extended fights.

warwick.playstyle: Sustain jungler. W tracks low HP enemies. R long-range lockdown. Great for beginners.

wukong.playstyle: Teamfight diver. R double-knockup = game-winning CC. W clone for outplays.

xayah.playstyle: Feather-root ADC. Setup feathers behind enemies then E root for lockdown. R = untargetable.

xin_zhao.playstyle: Early game ganker. E dash + Q knockup for ganks. R blocks ranged damage.

yasuo.playstyle: High-skill melee carry. Dash through minions. Windwall blocks projectiles. R on knockups.

yone.playstyle: Dual-damage skirmisher. E engages allow risk-free trades. R is massive engage tool.

yuumi.playstyle: Attach enchanter. Sit on carry, buff them. Untargetable while attached. R for AoE roots.

zed.playstyle: AD assassin. W shadow combos for poke. R all-in for kill. QSS/Stasis counter R.

zeri.playstyle: Mobile ADC with skillshot AAs. E dashes through walls. R grants ramping MS+damage.

ziggs.playstyle: Siege/poke mage. Q spam for poke. W satchel for mobility. R global AoE nuke.

zilean.playstyle: Utility support. Double Q stun. E massive speed/slow. R is free Guardian Angel for carry.

zoe.playstyle: One-shot poke mage. E sleep into long-range Q for massive burst. W steals spells.

zyra.playstyle: Zone control support. Plants deal constant damage. E root for CC. R AoE knockup in teamfights.
